programs.heading: Maintenance Programs
programs.name: Name
programs.title: Title
programs.intervalHelp: Set at least one interval. Leave unused intervals and warnings blank. Uncheck “Whichever occurs first” to require both thresholds.
programs.precedence: Priority: Vehicle → Brand/Model → Brand → Department → Location → Category → Fuel Type. The newest rule wins ties. Only one program governs each vehicle.
programs.departmentHelp: Department comes from the driver on an active Vehicle Assignment, with the legacy assigned driver as fallback. Future rules take effect during scheduled synchronization.
programs.complianceHelp: Task compliance = (current + due soon) ÷ all active tasks. Due today, overdue and missing baselines are not compliant. Program coverage measures assigned vehicles separately. No tasks displays “—”.
programs.emptyPrograms: Create a program, add its tasks, then assign it to vehicles.

programs.scheduleHelp: The assigned Program calculates the next reminder after this Service is completed.

inspectionTemplates.snapshotHelp: Each inspection keeps the checklist and rules it began with. Template changes apply to future inspections.
inspectionTemplates.precedence: Selection per inspection type: vehicle → brand/model → category → fuel type → location → department. An exact model wins over a brand. Then higher priority wins; ties use the oldest assignment ID. Department uses the handover driver or current assigned driver.
inspectionTemplates.scheduleHelp: Schedules apply where this template wins selection. Calendar periods start on the chosen date (UTC). Mileage needs a known odometer and a shared baseline. Before check-out requires a passed inspection for that handover day; after return creates a required inspection.
